notes.subject: עשנת
notes.rationale: 'smolder/smoke (of anger)' — KJV/ASV 'be angry', YLT 'burn', BSB 'smolder'; Tok Pisin keeps the smoke-picture.

notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: Direct lament-address to Yahwe Elohim Tsebaot with a 'how long' question.

notes.subject: paia i smok
notes.rationale: Hebrew verb is literally 'you smoke'; anger is supplied by context, smoke-shape kept.

translation: Yahwe Elohim Tsebaot, i no long taim stret yu wok long mekim paia i smok ⟨i⟩ long praia bilong ol manmeri bilong yu!

tokens.gloss: yu wok long mekim paia i smok
